title: Chaparelle at Still Austin Quarter
location: Still Austin Quarter, 4211 Willow Springs Rd, Austin, TX 78745
description: Alt-country group Chaparelle performs a free show at the new Still Austin Quarter. Doors open at 6:00 PM with the show starting at 8:00 PM.

title: Fel-East Navidad Christmas Pop-Up
description: East End Ballroom is transforming its casita into Fel-East Navidad, a 1970s Latin American-inspired Christmas cantina featuring holiday cocktails, weekly specials, bingo, and festive community events.

title: Chaparelle
location: The Still Austin Quarter, 4211 Willow Springs Rd.
description: Austin alt-country supergroup Chaparelle takes the stage for a free night of live music at the new South Austin venue.

title: CJ Hendry Flower Shop Pop-Up
description: Australian artist CJ Hendry brings her flower shop pop-up to East Austin, featuring a whimsical wonderland of oversized collectible plush flowers.

title: Seismic Dance Event 9.0
description: Seismic Dance Event 9.0 returns to The Concourse Project from November 13-15 featuring a full lineup of electronic music artists.

title: Creek Show
description: Creek Show features ten light-based installations created by local artists illuminating Waller Creek from 4th St to Lady Bird Lake, alongside food, drinks, and special activities at Creek Monster Cove.

title: Precision Camera Holiday Expo
description: Precision Camera & Video hosts their annual Holiday Expo featuring free photography and videography classes, hands-on gear exploration, and exclusive holiday deals on top brands like Sony, Canon, and Fujifilm.

title: Free Tree Adoption at Tech Ridge H-E-B
description: TreeFolks NeighborWoods Program is offering free tree adoptions on a first-come, first-served basis for Austin residents. Bring an Austin Energy bill or proof of residence to adopt up to two trees per household.

title: Kinda Good Tattoo Convention
description: Kinda Good Tattoo Convention featuring flash tattoos, local vintage vendors, makers, food, and live entertainment at Kinda Tropical. Sign-ups start each day at 11am sharp.

title: Honky Tonk Fest
location: Star Hill Ranch, 1500 Hamilton Pool Road
description: Honky Tonk Fest by Austin Monthly returns featuring live music from Rattlesnake Milk, The Deslondes, Summer Dean, and more, plus two-step dance lessons, Chicken Sh!t Bingo, and local food & drinks.

title: Honky Tonk Fest
description: Honky Tonk Fest returns to Star Hill Ranch featuring 10 live music artists across two stages, two-step lessons, custom hat shaping, local vendors, food, drinks, and Chicken Shit Bingo.

title: Austin Mac & Cheese Festival
description: The Austin Mac & Cheese Festival brings cheesy creations from some of Austin's best chefs to Star Hill Ranch, where attendees can taste delicious bites and help crown the champion.

title: Pre-Thanksgiving Party at Koko's Bavarian
description: Koko's Bavarian is throwing a pre-Thanksgiving party featuring $8 frozen drinks, $12 pint + pie shot combos, and DJ Diggy Dutch playing throughout the night.

title: 🟦 WWW started on August 20, 2015...

title: Texas Wienerfest
description: Texas Wienerfest is the world's largest Dachshund meetup featuring amateur dog races, live music, low rider limbo, wiener wellness spa, pup cup eating contest, and more.
